r0.unit: One tile / summer; exclusive full node
evidence: WY2026 five-tile campaign: 122 summer scenes per tile, maintained in-memory construction.
Request all node memory and exclusive access; one CPU requested does not mean the rest of the node is shared. Additional compute threads have not been benchmarked.

tile_inversion.unit: One tile / date spectral inversion worker
evidence: Operator baseline: one worker and 6 GiB per tile/date.
This is not the budget for a complete multi-tile cloud/preparation job.

daily_single_tile.unit: One date with one tile, clouds, retrieval and daily albedo
evidence: 6 GiB worker baseline plus 2 GiB coordinator headroom; validate a pilot with the complete runner.

daily_five_tiles.unit: One date across up to five tiles, one retrieval worker per tile
evidence: Five-tile 16 GiB trial and historical preparation completed; observed preparation peak was below 10 GiB.
The current runner adds daily albedo; validate the complete runner before treating that measurement as its guarantee.

nrt_five_tiles.unit: One NRT cycle over up to five tiles; serialized updates to one stream
evidence: Preparation uses the five-tile measured budget; complete cycle time/memory still needs validation.
The allocation must also cover the interpolation settings registered with the stream. No cron or Slurm job is created by selecting this profile.

interpolation_screen.unit: One tile / row stripe over the historical interval
evidence: 600 screening tasks completed in the five-tile WY2026 campaign with this per-task allocation.

interpolation_spatial.unit: One date across the full five-tile donor domain
evidence: 2026-11-06: 76 completed spatial tasks had a maximum sampled MaxRSS of 1.30 GiB, median 0.75 GiB.
Four CPUs support the multithreaded spatial kernel; 8 GiB retains headroom. Full winter/spring coverage remains to be checked.

Campaign array 29341812 was changed from 24 GiB / concurrency 4 to 8 GiB / concurrency 8, split manually across blanca-snow and blanca-rittger. This profile selects one queue; it does not reproduce that split automatically.

interpolation_properties.unit: One tile / row stripe over the historical interval
evidence: Retain until the property-completion pilot has measured CPU, peak memory and runtime.
Retain until export has measured CPU, peak memory and runtime.
